profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Samsara | Vue, Python, AWS, PostgreSQL | Building CardAtlas (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase)
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer focused on building scalable, user-first products.

At Samsara, I work primarily with Vue, Python, AWS, and PostgreSQL — building and maintaining production systems used at scale.

Outside of work, I’m building CardAtlas, a platform for Pokémon collectors to track, trade, and discover cards, using Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase.

I enjoy working across the stack and care deeply about performance, UX, and clean architecture.
Always interested in building products that people actually use.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Handle load of over 2.5 million users/month by optimizing the load time for fabfitfun.com through compression/optimization of images, minification, caching, and reducing calls and redirects
• Integrated PayPal, leading to an increase in conversions by over 10%
• Implemented a lightweight address verification module in Vanilla JS to standardize and sanitize shipping addresses for over 1 million users

positions.title: Information Technology Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Provided technical support for 4000+ users on hardware, software, network, and phone equipment.
• Identified, documented, and monitored technical problems and escalated to correct technicians.
• Maintained records of all inbound tickets/calls, communication, and assignments in help desk system. Reset networks, system access, and passwords.
